parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false in the flags but is structurally a sample-app file by its directory path ('WallpaperSampleApp'). Per the decision rules, a record residing under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the flag value. The duplication of 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' as a type-alias-object in 'DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' versus 'WallpaperSampleApp/DebugHUD.swift' is therefore an intentional mirror of a debug/HUD utility inside a sample application, and lifting it into shared production code would couple production targets to sample-app semantics. No refactor is warranted.
